title: 第4回小樽地域遺産「塩谷・桃内」大会
address: 北海道小樽市塩谷2丁目25-1
mapQuery: 徳源寺 北海道小樽市塩谷2丁目25-1
summary: 塩谷・桃内の地域遺産を巡り、講演やトークを通じてまちづくりへの活用を考える大会。事前申込は9月20日で締め切られています。
description: 小樽地域遺産連合会による第4回大会。徳源寺を会場に、塩谷・桃内の地域遺産を巡るまち歩き、基調講演、歴史に関する講演、トークセッションなどを予定しています。定員80人、参加費1,000円（資料・弁当付き）。事前申込の締切は2026年9月20日です。参加可否は主催者へご確認ください。
source: 小樽観光協会／小樽地域遺産連合会
audience: 地域の歴史・文化やまちづくりに関心のある方
reservation: 要事前申込・先着80人。申込締切は2026年9月20日（受付終了）。

en.name: 4th Otaru Regional Heritage Conference: Shioya and Momonai
en.summary: A conference and guided walk exploring the heritage of Otaru’s Shioya and Momonai districts. Advance registration closed on September 20.
en.description: The Otaru Regional Heritage Association will host a guided heritage walk, lectures and discussions at Tokugenji Temple on how local history can support community development. Capacity is 80. The fee is JPY 1,000 including materials and lunch. The September 20 registration deadline has passed; contact the organizer to ask about attendance.
en.address: 2-25-1 Shioya, Otaru, Hokkaido, Japan（北海道小樽市塩谷2丁目25-1）
en.audience: People interested in local history, culture and community development
en.reservation: Advance registration required; first 80 applicants. Registration closed September 20, 2026.

en.name: 2nd Otaru Port Square Flea Market
en.summary: Antiques, vintage items and other goods at Otaru Port Square. Free admission; held in rain but cancelled in severe weather.
en.description: The second flea market at Otaru Port Square brings antiques, old tools and miscellaneous goods to the event plaza by the port. Food and drinks are also available at the adjacent Container Village. Admission is free. The market runs from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM JST and may be cancelled in severe weather.

title: OTARU RETRO MODERN DAY 2026
place: 旧カトリック住ノ江教会「十字路」聖堂
address: 北海道小樽市住ノ江2丁目2-7

organizer: ヒロミノキモノ／BLUTIA × こめとわ × 小樽商科大学映像研究会
audience: 小樽市民・観光客・家族連れ
reservation: 入場申込の要否は告知画像に記載されていません。主催者へご確認ください。

en.name: OTARU RETRO MODERN DAY 2026
en.summary: A free cultural day at a historic former church in Otaru, with kimono-dress shows, films, a market, workshops and food trucks.
en.description: At the former Catholic Suminoe Church ‘Jūjiro’ chapel, visitors can see a fashion show of dresses made from uncut kimono, a View magazine stage, films about Otaru by Otaru University of Commerce students, a market, workshops and food trucks. Admission is free. Details are from the organizer-supplied flyer; no event-specific organizer web page was confirmed.
